lines.t: (Verse 1)
When you cry in the night,
I am there by your side.
When the silence feels too deep,
I am watching while you sleep.
Every tear that you’ve cried,
I’ve counted and sanctified.
Every scar you try to hide—
I’ve turned to light inside.
(Pre-Chorus)
Can you feel My heart beating in your own?
Every breath you breathe, you’re never on your own.
(Chorus)
You’re never alone, I am near,
My love has been with you all these years.
Before the stars, before the dawn,
I called your name—you’ve always belonged.
You’re never alone, My child,
Rest in My arms awhile.
Even when the night feels long,
You’re never alone.
(Verse 2)
When the storm starts to rise,
Don’t believe the lies.
You were known before the world began,
Carved in the Father’s hand.
I am the light that breaks your chains,
The peace that calms your pain.
In every whisper, hear My tone,
“My beloved, you are My own.”
(Bridge)
I am the fire, the breath, the flame,
The endless love that knows your name.
Though heaven and earth will fade away,
My heart for you remains the same.
(Final Chorus)
You’re never alone, I am near,
My love has been with you all these years.
Before the stars, before the dawn,
I called your name—you’ve always belonged.
You’re never alone, My child,
Rest in My arms awhile.
Even when the night feels long…
You’re never alone.
You’re never alone.
(Soft outro)
You’re never… alone.
